import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Add import for LegendPropagationSystem after existing imports
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's|import { QuestEngine } from \"../modules/quest/QuestEngine.js\";|import { QuestEngine } from \"../modules/quest/QuestEngine.js\";\\nimport { LegendPropagationSystem } from \"../systems/LegendPropagationSystem.js\";|' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Added import")

# Find line where npcSystem.tick is called to add LegendPropagationSystem call after it
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'this.npcSystem.tick' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Found:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
